response.sql: WITH ch AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL), bm AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS benchmark FROM ch) SELECT AVG(ch.avg_rate) AS mean_avg_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(ch.avg_rate - bm.benchmark) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM ch CROSS JOIN bm WHERE ch.avg_rate > bm.benchmark

assumptions.assumption: Only fees rows that match an order (inner join) are used; channels with NULL orderbase form their own group and are included as a channel if present, unless all their feerates are null.
Channels whose feerates are all NULL have no average and are excluded from the benchmark mean.
If no channel is strictly above the benchmark (e.g., all equal), the query returns one row with NULLs.
